assistant.label: RailEase assistant
assistant.title: যাত্ৰা সহায়ক
assistant.welcome: Hello! I can explain railway terms, recommendations, quotas, bookings and itineraries.
assistant.fallback: I can help with RAC, quota eligibility, cancellation, tickets, or making an itinerary cheaper.
assistant.promptQuota: Why can't I select this quota?

answers.rac: RAC means Reservation Against Cancellation. You can board the train, and a full berth may be assigned if cancellations occur.
answers.quota: Quota eligibility is checked before payment. Choose ‘View all quotas’ to see requirements in plain language.
answers.cancellation: Cancellation charges depend on time before departure and booking status. No confirmed booking is created after a failed payment.
answers.ticket: Open My Trips, choose the relevant tab, then select View ticket.
answers.cheaper: Try removing premium activities, choosing a 3-star stay, or switching the itinerary pace to Relaxed.

footer.description: Prototype for citizen-first Indian travel. Not an official railway booking service.

confirm.infoId: Carry valid government identification during the journey.
confirm.infoFailure: Failed or cancelled payments never create a confirmed booking.
confirm.unavailable: This journey is no longer bookable. Return to results and choose an alternative.

payment.qrInstructions: Generate a secure, single-use QR code for the exact booking amount.
payment.scanWithUpi: Scan this code using any supported UPI app.
payment.generateQrText: The QR is generated only when you are ready, and is valid for 15 minutes.
payment.qrWaiting: QR created. Scan it, complete payment, then check the status.
payment.qrNotReceived: Payment has not been received yet. Complete it in your UPI app and check again.
payment.qrMockMessage: Razorpay credentials are not configured. This is a non-scannable test preview; choose a simulation result below.
payment.qrCreateError: Unable to create a QR payment.
payment.qrStatusError: Unable to check the QR payment status.
payment.qrExpired: This QR code has expired. Generate a new QR to continue.
payment.cardCheckoutTitle: Continue with a debit or credit card

payment.upiIdError: Enter a valid UPI ID, such as success@razorpay.
payment.upiIdTestNote: Enter a Razorpay test UPI ID to test the payment response.
payment.upiCollectNotice: Manual UPI-ID Collect is test-only here. For live payments, customers use UPI apps (Intent) on mobile or scan a dynamic QR on desktop.
payment.confirmed: বুকিং নিশ্চিত হৈছে। আপোনাৰ টিকট প্ৰস্তুত কৰি আছে…
payment.noCredentials: Test credentials are not configured. Choose a simulation result below.
payment.createError: Unable to create a payment order.
payment.verifyError: Payment could not be verified. No booking was created.
payment.cancelled: Payment was cancelled. Your journey is still saved.
payment.openError: The secure checkout could not open. Check your connection and try again.
payment.failed: Test payment failed. No booking was created.
payment.testCancelled: Test payment cancelled. No booking was created.
payment.passengerInfoRequiredText: Add the required number of passengers and complete all selected quota verification details before payment.
